ProduDash internal alpha media-tool notice
==========================================

Approval reference
------------------

OWNER-DIRECTIVE-2026-07-27-PRODUDASH-ALPHA1-WIN-REBUILD

Recorded by the repository owner on 2026-07-27 for the private
0.1.0-alpha.1 Windows x64 prerelease. ProduDash is a single-owner project,
so this reference records the owner's own decision to bundle these GPL
media tools at this scope. It is not an approval to publish the
application or its bundled media tools publicly.

This supersedes OWNER-DIRECTIVE-2026-07-26-PRODUDASH-ALPHA1-WIN. The
binaries approved under that reference imported libwinpthread-1.dll, which
was not bundled and is not provided by Windows, so they exited 0xC0000135
(STATUS_DLL_NOT_FOUND) and never ran. They are replaced by the rebuild
described below.

FFmpeg
------

Version: 8.1.2
Source: https://ffmpeg.org/releases/ffmpeg-8.1.2.tar.xz
Signature: https://ffmpeg.org/releases/ffmpeg-8.1.2.tar.xz.asc
Release-key fingerprint: FCF986EA15E6E293A5644F10B4322F04D67658D8
Signature verification: successful; good signature from "FFmpeg release
  signing key <ffmpeg-devel@ffmpeg.org>", primary key fingerprint matching
  the value above
Source modifications: none

x264
----

Commit: b35605ace3ddf7c1a5d67a2eb553f034aef41d55
Canonical source:
  https://code.videolan.org/videolan/x264/-/commit/b35605ace3ddf7c1a5d67a2eb553f034aef41d55
Obtained from: https://github.com/mirror/x264 because the canonical host
  was unreachable behind an anti-bot challenge. The commit was fetched by
  SHA and the checked-out tree was confirmed to equal the pinned commit, so
  the content is identical to the canonical source regardless of host.
Source modifications: none

Build
-----

Target: Windows x64 (x86_64-w64-mingw32)
Build host: Windows x64, native build under MSYS2
Compiler: mingw-w64 GCC 16.1.0
Assembler: NASM 3.02
FFmpeg license reported by the built binaries: GPL version 2 or later
Nonfree components: disabled
Network protocols: disabled; the built binaries expose no network protocol

x264 configuration:

  ./configure --host=x86_64-w64-mingw32 --enable-static --disable-cli
  --disable-opencl

FFmpeg configuration:

  ./configure --arch=x86_64 --target-os=mingw32 --disable-debug
  --disable-doc --disable-ffplay --disable-network --disable-autodetect
  --enable-static --disable-shared --enable-gpl --enable-libx264
  --pkg-config-flags=--static --extra-cflags=-I<deps>/include
  --extra-ldflags="-L<deps>/lib -static"

Differences from the superseded 2026-07-26 bundle:

  1. -static was added to --extra-ldflags. This is the fix for the load
     failure: without it, mingw-w64 resolved libwinpthread-1.dll at run
     time. The built programs now import only Windows system libraries.
  2. --disable-asm was dropped because NASM is available on this build
     host, restoring SIMD acceleration. The macOS arm64 bundle was never
     built with --disable-asm, so this brings the two targets closer
     together rather than further apart.
  3. The build is native under MSYS2 rather than cross-compiled from
     macOS. The source, the x264 commit, the compiler version, and every
     feature flag are otherwise unchanged.

The x264 library was linked statically so ProduDash retains its existing
H.264/AAC render behavior. The resulting ffmpeg.exe and ffprobe.exe
programs are separate executables launched by ProduDash.

This Windows bundle is built from the same FFmpeg 8.1.2 release tarball and
the same x264 commit as the macOS arm64 bundle, with matching feature
configuration, so render behavior stays consistent across platforms.

License
-------

This bundle contains FFmpeg and x264 under GPL-2.0-or-later. The complete
GPL version 2 license text is included as NOTICE-GPL-2.0.txt. Copyrights
remain with their respective authors. These programs are provided without
warranty.

For any distribution beyond this private internal alpha, retain this
notice and the license text, make the exact corresponding FFmpeg 8.1.2 and
x264 source available with the distributed binaries, and complete the
owner's release compliance review.
